week_label: Launch week. First delivery Tuesday 8 September.

boxes.name: Taster Box
boxes.contents: Lasagne, the Sunday ragu, 2 kids dishes of your choice and this week's pudding. 5 tubs, worth £26.50 bought as dishes.

boxes.name: Family Box
boxes.contents: Any 4 adult mains, any 3 kids dishes and 1 pizza, chosen by you. Tell us your choices in the order notes.

dishes.name: Beef lasagne
dishes.description: Olsi's slow beef ragu layered with pasta and a proper bechamel. 45 minutes in the oven from frozen.

dishes.name: The Sunday ragu
dishes.description: Beef shin cooked slowly until it falls apart. Serve over pasta, mash or polenta.

dishes.name: Chicken and leek pie
dishes.description: Chicken thigh and leek in a cream sauce under shortcrust pastry.

dishes.name: Fish pie
dishes.description: Smoked haddock and salmon in a parsley sauce under buttery mash.

dishes.name: Mild chicken and butternut curry
dishes.description: Gently spiced with a coconut base, made with small people in mind. Serve with rice.

dishes.name: Aubergine parmigiana
dishes.description: Roasted aubergine, tomato sauce and mozzarella, baked until bubbling. Vegetarian.

dishes.name: 5-veg pasta Bolognese
dishes.description: Beef Bolognese with carrot, courgette, red pepper, onion and celery blended smooth into the sauce.

dishes.name: Mac and cheese
dishes.description: Macaroni cheese with butternut squash and cauliflower blended through the sauce. You cannot see either.

dishes.name: Meatballs in tomato sauce
dishes.description: Beef meatballs in a smooth tomato sauce carrying 5 vegetables. None of them visible.

dishes.name: Margherita
dishes.description: Par-baked base, tomato, mozzarella, basil. 8 minutes in your own oven.

dishes.name: Pepperoni
dishes.description: The margherita plus pepperoni. Same par-baked base, 8 minutes in your own oven.

dishes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
dishes.description: Date sponge with toffee sauce in the tub. Serves 2. Warm it through and add cream if you have it.

dishes.name: Fruity smoothie pack
dishes.description: For kids. Frozen banana, strawberry, mango and oats, portioned for 4 smoothies. Add milk and blend.

dishes.name: Green smoothie pack
dishes.description: For parents. Frozen spinach, mango, pineapple, lime and ginger, portioned for 4 smoothies. Add water or juice and blend.

dishes.name: This week's bake: banana and oat loaf
dishes.description: A whole loaf, baked at the weekend, sliced and frozen. Toast slices straight from the freezer.
